mapper.select: select count(id) from sys_register_application where type = 'ENTERPRISE' and verify_status = 'PENDING'

select tp.id as plan_id, tp.version as plan_version, tp.status as plan_status, tp.expire_time as plan_expire_time from sys_register_application ra left join sys_user su on su.id = ra.user_id left join tenant_plan tp on tp.organization_id = su.last_organization_id where ra.id = #{id}
select verify_remark from sys_register_application where phone = #{phone} and verify_status = 'REJECTED' order by create_time desc limit 1
